source.note: DFG SAMPLE, not a fixture. A snapshot of api.get_dfg output, for looking at the process map. Only its shape is asserted; re-pull rather than edit it.

data_honesty.succession: Counted within each object's own event sequence, over the whole log, no windowing. A succession is an observation, not a traceability claim.
data_honesty.truncation: GH Archive caps PushEvent.commits at 20; commit sequences undercount pushes larger than that.
data_honesty.commit_time: first-seen in PushEvent, NOT real git commit time
data_honesty.cross_edges: Derived through the admitted links, which two admission rules narrow. Every cross-edge count is a floor, never a point estimate. One row per link class, link_-prefixed: the classification belongs to the link a succession rides on, never to the succession itself.
